appearance.silhouette: 긴 머리를 붉은 끈으로 낮게 묶은 마른 성인 한국인 의식 담당. 오른손의 작은 방울 주술패 한 개와 왼쪽 허리의 아이 손바닥 크기 천 조각 세 장이 읽힌다.
appearance.weapon: 오른손에 쥔 작은 방울 주술패 한 개
equipment: 왼쪽 허리: 붉은 끈에 매단 아이 손바닥 크기 천 조각 3장
appearance.costume: 해진 조선계 무명 저고리와 바지, 짧은 어두운 덧옷. 무광 천과 낡은 황동만 사용한다.
appearance.posePolicy: 정면에 가까운 3/4 전신 중립 자세. 양발을 보이고 오른손 방울패와 왼쪽 허리 천 조각을 가리지 않는다.

requiredElements: 왼쪽 허리 천 조각 3장과 붉은 머리끈
prohibitedElements: 일본 무녀·신토 장식·중국 도사 복식으로 치환
실존 역사 인물의 얼굴이나 초상 재현
characterSingleImage.visualStyle: ProjectBS rough low-density open ink/mok-seon with sparse broad pastel masses; broken variable-pressure brush lines, large unpainted interior areas, no polished cel or 3D rendering
characterSingleImage.composition: one full-body subject, near-front 3/4 neutral readable pose, head to toe and all equipment visible

phases: f0 grounded ready: bell plaque remains in anatomical RIGHT hand; exactly three cloth tags remain tied at anatomical LEFT waist
f1 selection: anatomical LEFT hand reaches to the three existing waist tags; lower body compresses without root drift
f2 load: LEFT hand cleanly removes exactly one existing tag, leaving exactly two tied at the waist; torso counter-rotates while RIGHT-hand bell stays controlled
f3 cast preparation: grounded hip-to-ribcage turn carries the selected tag screen-right; no duplicate tag or new equipment

f4 release boundary: selected tag leaves the character sprite and becomes gameplay-projectile responsibility; show no flying charm, projectile trail, or loose duplicate; exactly two tags remain at waist
f5 controlled bell-and-torso follow-through: RIGHT hand keeps the one bell plaque, feet readable, no second attack
f6 recovery: weight returns over the root; no loose tag in either hand and exactly two remain attached

f7 ready-transition end: calm compatible recovery with bell retained and no loose projectile; gameplay state may restore the canonical third waist tag only when returning to idle, never as an in-sequence pop

no added weapon, bell, tag, talisman, or cultural substitute
